QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Pack Up, and Set Sail 1
QuestInfo.0: You had to prepare for the expedition. Leon probably knew what you needed to pack.
QuestInfo.1: You had to prepare for the expedition. Leon probably knew what you needed to pack. He said it'd be different this time, because you were going to be at sea...
QuestInfo.2: You had to prepare for the expedition. Leon probably knew what you needed to pack. He said it'd be different this time, because you were going to be at sea... You realized he wasn't being all that helpful.

0.1: It's kind of a given, but when you fight pirates, you fight on the open sea.
0.2: We're going to need to be ready. Like SUPER ready. We're not going up against a buncha fishmen this time, know what I mean?

yes.0: Of course you know what I mean! I'm excellent at explaining stuff.

no.0: Oh, sorry. I mean Delfinos are descended from fish, and these guys are not so the fight will be tougher.

1.0: We're gonna need some food, some water, maybe some like rocks and stuff in case the boat gets messed up.
1.1: Oh, we should probably find a crew too.

yes.0: All right! I'm gonna go think of my perfect crew and put it out in the universe. Gimme a minute.
